description: Per-scenario label audit of data/synthetic/raw (541 scenarios), produced by a multi-agent audit of why GRPO groups were zero-variance. A scenario with a non-empty 'blocking' list has a gold label under which the policy-correct action (per data/tau2/domains/retail/policy.md) scores 0 -- training on it pushes the policy away from the retail policy and, because every policy-following sample scores the same 0, it also produces flat groups. 'labels' are informational. gold_ids_unreachable is computed live against tau_forge.train.grounding at the time of writing; the rest are auditor judgements (writes: all 150 read; reads/no-call: all 284 read; out_of_scope: all 107 read), adversarially re-checked.

blocking_labels.confirmation_missing: gold is a DB write but the user never gave an explicit yes to the listed action; policy requires asking first
blocking_labels.auth_missing: gold write acts for a user who never authenticated (email, or name+zip)
blocking_labels.gold_ids_unreachable: a gold id argument appears nowhere in the grounded prompt; only a guess can produce it
blocking_labels.unauth_policy_conflict: read gold with no authentication in context; policy-correct move is to authenticate first
blocking_labels.unauthenticated_identity_given_lookup_du: out_of_scope: the user gave identity but no lookup happened; policy-correct move is to authenticate
blocking_labels.unauthenticated_no_identity: out_of_scope: no identity at all; policy-correct move is to ask for it
blocking_labels.gold_should_be_deny: out_of_scope transfer where policy.md says to deny (contradicts policy_violation labels for the same rule)
blocking_labels.gold_should_be_plain_reply: out_of_scope transfer for an information question the agent can just answer
blocking_labels.grounding_reveals_foreign_order: grounded context shows the gold order belongs to another user; refusing becomes correct
blocking_labels.grounding_contradicts_narration: prose narrates a prior write the db.json state does not reflect
blocking_labels.malformed_dialogue: consecutive user turns, nothing actually confirmed
blocking_labels.label_error: gold modifies an order the narrative says is already 'pending (item modified)'
